name: Legion of Doom
description:
The game puts you in the shoes of brave and relentless heroes, set on a difficult and demanding quest: defeating the legendary and formidable Legion of Doom.

Get ready for some hardcore, fantasy action, featuring: 
• 5 unique playable characters
• 3 distinguished campaigns
• Swarm of custom enemies and over 15 boss monsters 
• Over 30 weapons and special abilities
• Over 20 powerful & upgradeable perks
• Singleplayer and Multiplayer Local Co-op
• Building & crafting structures
• 7 optional Traits to spice up the playthrough
• DOZENS of hours of gameplay
• Ridiculous replayability
• Hundreds of playstyle combinations (characters + perks + traits + weapons)

The unholy legion consists of various and nightmarish creatures, which will test your skills, reflex, tenacity & guts. 

On the battlefield you level up, expand and become honed and hardened, quickly gaining strength against the dark forces. 

The fight is fierce, but even defeated - you grow stronger and more powerful by unlocking & upgrading new perks, gear, and characters.

Defeat enemies, gather loot, upgrade your gear, level up & conquer the LEGION OF DOOM!
